items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I was there when Louie first get off the boat... Louie always was a very fine fellow.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, Tiny was no reader, but he was a good showman on the drums. So he stayed there for about a year. Then he went with Louis, then Louis
Russell. Then he came in and he put him in front of a band, said, you get your own band, and that's when he went to the top.
